positions.as_written: Expect inverse dynamics to underestimate joint load where co-contraction is likely, which includes most symptomatic knees.
Treat instrumented implant data as the direct measurement and the rest as computed.
Treat the kinetic account as the one that explains disease progression, since cartilage responds to load rather than to motion.
Address muscle capacity alongside any mechanical correction, since co-contraction and weakness both raise load.
